questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Bounding boxes and labels” in this lesson?
options: This topic removes the need to validate inputs or inspect model outputs.
This topic guarantees identical results across all devices and package versions.
This topic makes every serialized checkpoint safe to load from an unknown source.
Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.
questions.answer_key: Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.
questions.explanation: Bounding boxes and labels: Inspect one sample before batching, verify feature/label alignment, and confirm that preprocessing and split boundaries fit the intended stage.

questions.prompt: Before relying on “Detection model inputs and outputs”, what should a learner verify?
options: Use the held-out test split repeatedly to tune the model and report that score as unbiased.
Skip recording package versions because they cannot affect API or device behavior.
confirm image layout, numeric range, normalization, label format, and that validation/inference do not use random training-only augmentation.
Assume all tensor dimensions and devices are interchangeable without checking them.
questions.answer_key: confirm image layout, numeric range, normalization, label format, and that validation/inference do not use random training-only augmentation.
questions.explanation: This lesson recommends the following check: confirm image layout, numeric range, normalization, label format, and that validation/inference do not use random training-only augmentation.

questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Object-detection metrics”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not normalize or resize inference images differently from the preprocessing used during training.
Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not normalize or resize inference images differently from the preprocessing used during training.
questions.explanation: This topic-specific caution is important: Do not normalize or resize inference images differently from the preprocessing used during training.
